$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (openspec/changes/sources-ecb-exchange-rates). Declares the `exchange_rate` schema in register `integriq` and seeds the credential-free `ecb-eurofxref-daily` source for the euro foreign exchange reference rates of the European Central Bank. The rates are stored by OCA\Integriq\BackgroundJob\ExchangeRateSyncJob through ExchangeRateImportService, not by a seeded mapping and synchronization: the ECB file carries the date on the parent `Cube time` element and the rate on each child `Cube currency`, so a per-item synchronization never sees the date of the item it maps (design.md D1). Any app reads the rates as OpenRegister objects: GET /apps/openregister/api/objects/integriq/exchange_rate?currency=USD&rateDate=2026-10-30. Authorization: any signed-in account reads; create, update and delete are EMPTY lists, which leaves them to the `admin` group (a non-empty block denies every action it does not grant, see 99-event-create-lockdown.json). The import writes in system context (`_rbac: false`).

exchange_rate.title: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.summary: One reference rate of one currency against a base currency on one publication date
exchange_rate.description: Units of `currency` per one unit of `baseCurrency` on `rateDate`, as published by `source`. The ECB source stores base currency EUR, one object per currency per working day, never the same source, currency and date twice. The ECB publishes no rate on weekends and TARGET holidays: a reader that needs the rate for such a day takes the newest `rateDate` on or before it.

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of the base currency; always EUR for the ECB source
baseCurrency.title: Base currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the quoted currency
currency.title: Currency

rateDate.description: The publication date the rate applies to
rateDate.title: Rate date

rate.description: Units of `currency` per one unit of `baseCurrency`
rate.title: Rate

source.description: Who published the rate; `ecb` for the European Central Bank reference rates
source.title: Source

objects.name: ECB euro reference rates
objects.description: The euro foreign exchange reference rates the European Central Bank publishes every working day around 16:00 CET (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html). Public and credential-free, so it ships enabled. ExchangeRateSyncJob reads `location` four times a day and stores each rate as an `exchange_rate` object; the first run against an empty store reads `configuration.historyLocation` instead, for the last 90 days. Disable the source to stop the import.
